description: If the base and step graphs are \(\Sigma_1\) up to PA equivalence, their specified beta-coded primitive-recursion graph is also \(\Sigma_1\) up to PA equivalence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursion_sigmaOne {n : ℕ}
  (base : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (step : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 2) ⊕ Unit))
  (hbase : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.SigmaOneEquivalent base)
  (hstep : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.SigmaOneEquivalent step) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.SigmaOneEquivalent
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step)
